an4.15:1.1: imā bhikkhave aggapaññattiyo. Katamā catasso? Etadaggaṃ bhikkhave attabhāvīnaṃ yadidaṃ Rāhu asurindo, etadaggaṃ bhikkhave kāmabhogīnaṃ yadidaṃ rājā Mandhātā, etadaggaṃ bhikkhave ādhipateyyānaṃ yadidaṃ Māro pāpimā, sadevake bhikkhave loke samārake sabrahmake sassamaṇabrāhmaṇiyā pajāya sadevamanussāya Tathāgato aggam akkhāyati arahaṃ sammāsambuddho. Imā kho bhikkhave catasso aggapaññattiyo ti.
an4.15:2.1: Rāh' aggaṃ attabhāvīnaṃ Mandhātā kāmabhogīnaṃ Māro ādhipateyyānaṃ iddhiyā yasasā jalaṃ
an4.15:3.1: Uddhaṃ tiriyaṃ apācīnaṃ yāvatā jagato gati Sadevakassa lokassa Buddho aggaṃ pavuccatīti. Cattār'
